On Christ Lookinge on Peter

Thomas Fuller (1608–1661)

T
HO
 Peter w[it]h his tongue did Christ deny
Yet Christ, he owned Peter with his eye:
Peter who was with night of feares ore-drawn
But w[he]n ye Cocke did crowe ye day did dawn.
